import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp/dev")
import validate_out, ref

def run(reqs):
    payload = b"".join((json.dumps(r) + "\n").encode() for r in reqs)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

rng = random.Random(4242)

# 1) rule order invariance
base = {"services": ["a", "b", "c"], "rules": [
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["a", "b"]}},
    {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": ["b", "c"]}},
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "or", "args": [{"op": "match", "path": ["a", "b", "c"]},
                                                     {"op": "startswith", "path": ["c", "a"]}]}},
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": "contains", "path": ["b", "b"]}}}],
   "queries": [[], ["a", "b"], ["a", "b", "b"], ["c", "a"], ["b", "c"]]}
variants = [base]
for _ in range(6):
    v = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    rng.shuffle(v["rules"])
    variants.append(v)
outs = run(variants)
assert all(o == outs[0] for o in outs), "rule order affects output!"
print("rule order invariance: OK (%d variants, %d states)" % (len(variants), len(outs[0]["dfa"]["accept"])))

# 2) duplicated rules / repeated atoms invariance
v = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
v["rules"] = base["rules"] + [base["rules"][0], base["rules"][2]]
outs = run([base, v])
assert outs[0] == outs[1], "duplicated rules change output"
print("duplicate rule invariance: OK")

# 3) and/or argument order invariance (semantics commute)
v = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
v["rules"][2]["when"]["args"] = list(reversed(v["rules"][2]["when"]["args"]))
outs = run([base, v])
assert outs[0] == outs[1], "arg order changes output"
print("argument order invariance: OK")

# 4) unicode normalization must NOT happen
svc = ["\u00e9", "e\u0301", "E"]
req = {"services": svc, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["\u00e9"]}}],
       "queries": [["\u00e9"], ["e\u0301"], ["E"]]}
out = run([req])[0]
validate_out.validate(out, req, sample=10, rng=rng)
assert out["queries"][0]["allow"] is True
assert out["queries"][1]["allow"] is False
assert out["queries"][2]["allow"] is False
assert len(out["dfa"]["accept"]) == 4  # start, matched, failure-by-other-token... verify with reference
assert out == ref.ref_compile(req)
print("unicode no-normalization: OK", out["dfa"])

# 5) long query (4096 tokens)
svc = ["x", "y"]
req = {"services": svc, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["x", "y", "x"]}}],
       "queries": [["x"] * 4096, ["y"] * 2000 + ["x", "y", "x"], []]}
out = run([req])[0]
validate_out.validate(out, req, sample=5, rng=rng)
assert out["queries"][0]["allow"] is True
assert out["queries"][1]["allow"] is True
assert out["queries"][2]["allow"] is False
print("long queries: OK")

# 6) 256 queries
req = {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": ["a"]}}],
       "queries": [["a"] if i % 2 else [] for i in range(256)]}
out = run([req])[0]
assert len(out["queries"]) == 256
assert all(q["allow"] is (i % 2 == 1) for i, q in enumerate(out["queries"]))
validate_out.validate(out, req, sample=5, rng=rng)
print("256 queries: OK")
